director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj rectangles, squares aur polygons ka perimeter, cricket ground ki boundary jaisa. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
haan, samajh aaya

Cricket pitch ek lamba rectangle hoti hai, 22 m lambi aur 3 m chaudi. Groundsman pitch ke ek kone se chalna shuru kare, kinaare-kinaare chale aur wapas usi kone par pahunche, toh jitna woh chala, wahi pitch ka parimap hai. Theek hai, Riya.
haan samajh gayi

Sabhi ko jodkar parimap milega. Is triangle ki teen bhujayein hain: 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm. Ek kone se chalo, teeno bhujaon se hote hue wapas usi kone par aao. Yeh poora raasta hi triangle ka parimap hai. Toh is triangle ka parimap kitna hai?

director.text: 9 cm

Perimeter mein har side jodni hoti hai, sirf do nahi. Is khet ke kono ke naam A se F tak hain. Paanch kono wale khet PQRST mein PQ 8 m, QR 5 m, RS 7 m, ST 6 m aur TP 3 m hai. Khet ka parimap kitna hai?

Andar tiles bichhao toh woh area hai. Parimap ke liye kinaare ki bhujayein jodte hain, 5, 3, 5 aur 3, guna nahi karte. 9 cm lambe aur 2 cm chaude label ke kinaare par ek baar ribbon lagta hai. Ek triangle shape ki phoolon ki kyari hai. Iski bhujayein 7 m, 9 m aur 12 m hain. Kyari ke kinaare-kinaare ek baar baad lagani hai. Kitni lambi baad lagegi? Diya hai: kyari triangle shape ki hai, ek band shape, bhujayein 7 m, 9 m aur 12 m hain. Dhoondhna hai: baad ki lambai, yaani kyari ka parimap. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
haan
Teenon sides jodni hain: 7 plus 9 plus 12. Baad kinaare par lagti hai, toh teeno bhujayein jodo: P = 7 + 9 + 12, kyunki koi bhi bhuja chhooti toh baad adhoori reh jaayegi. Yahan tak theek hai?
mujhe lagta hai haan
Haan, step theek hai: ab 7, 9 aur 12 ko jodna hai. Pehle do bhujayein jodo: 7 + 9 = 16 m, kyunki ek kone se chalke do bhujayein poori hui, teesri abhi baaki hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
haan, samajh aaya
Ab 16 m mein teesri bhuja, 12 m, jodni hai, taaki perimeter poora ho. Ab teesri bhuja, 12 m, bhi jodo. 16 m mein 12 m jodkar kitna hua?

director.card: Ab teesri bhuja, 12 m, bhi jodo. 16 m mein 12 m jodkar kitna hua?

director.text: Haan, sahi hai. Haan, 28 m. Ab batao, 28 m kaise mila—16 mein 12 jodte waqt tumne kaunsa step socha?

Haan, sahi hai. Ek rectangle notebook cover 24 cm lamba aur 18 cm chauda hai. Iske kinaare par ek baar tape lagani hai. Kitni tape lagegi? Diya hai: cover rectangle shape ka hai, lambai 24 cm hai, chaudai 18 cm hai. Dhoondhna hai: tape ki lambai, yaani cover ka parimap. Ab tak samajh aaya?
mujhe nahi pata

Pehla joda: 24 cm plus 18 cm barabar 42 cm. Tape kinaare par lagti hai aur cover rectangle hai, toh parimap 2 × (lambai + chaudai) se nikalo: P = 2 × (24 + 18), kyunki kinaare par lambai do baar aati hai aur chaudai bhi do baar. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
haan, samajh aaya
24 plus 18 barabar 42 cm. Pehle bracket mein ek lambai aur ek chaudai jodo: 24 + 18 = 42 cm, kyunki 42 cm sirf aadha kinaara hai, ek kone se saamne wale kone tak. Yahan tak theek hai?

42 cm ek aadha kinaara hai; poora parimap paane ke liye is aadhe kinaare ko do baar lena hai. Ab is aadhe kinaare ko do baar lo. 2 × 42 kitna hota hai?

director.text: 10 m hai na

Haan, sahi hai. Is rectangle plot ki lambai 12 m aur chaudai 8 m hai. Taar poore kinaare par lagegi, toh parimap 2 × (12 + 8) = 40 m. Taar ₹10 per metre hai, toh kharcha 40 × 10 = ₹400. Agar kahin gate ho jahan taar nahi lagti, toh pehle uski lambai parimap se ghatate hain, phir guna karte hain. Isi plot mein 2 m ka gate hai jahan taar nahi lagegi. Ab kitne metre taar lagegi?

director.text: 38 metre

Haan, sahi hai. Rani 50 m lambe aur 30 m chaude rectangle park ke 3 chakkar daudti hai. Woh kul kitna daudti hai? Diya hai: park rectangle hai, lambai 50 m hai, chaudai 30 m hai, chakkar 3 hain. Dhoondhna hai: Rani kul kitni doori daudti hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
haan

Pehle ek chakkar ka parimap: 2 guna (50 plus 30) = 160 m. Ek chakkar ko park ke poore kinaare par ek baar daudna samjho: 1 chakkar = park ka parimap, kyunki chakkar kinaare par lagta hai, park ke andar nahi. Ab tak samajh aaya?
haan
Pehle ek chakkar 160 m tha. Park rectangle hai, toh parimap 2 × (lambai + chaudai) se likho: P = 2 × (50 + 30), kyunki kinaare par lambai do baar aati hai aur chaudai bhi do baar. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
mujhe lagta hai haan
Ek chakkar 160 m tha. Pehle bracket jodo: 50 + 30 = 80 m, kyunki 80 m sirf aadha chakkar hai, ek kone se saamne wale kone tak. Yahan tak theek hai?
haan, samajh aaya
Ise do baar lo: 2 × 80 = 160 m, kyunki aadha chakkar do baar lene se poora chakkar banta hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
haan, samajh aaya
Ek chakkar 160 m hai. Teeno chakkar barabar hain, toh ek chakkar ko 3 se guna karo: 3 chakkar = 3 × 160 m, kyunki har chakkar mein utni hi doori hai, 160 m. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
bas aaj ke liye itna hi
Theek hai Riya, tum aaj rukna chahti ho. Vikalp hain: aage badhein, thodi der ka viram lein, ya aaj ke liye band karein—tum kya chunogi?
